newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares down at noon on weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares down at noon on weak sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were down at midday on Wednesday with foreign institutions selling Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor and other blue chips amid weak market sentiment, brokers said.
The B share index fell 0.333 point or 0.45 percent to 73.162 on volume of $2.436 million worth $1.373 million, compared with 2.31 million shares on Tuesday morning.
Foreign investors were moving funds out of B shares to other more attractive markets such as Hong Kong. Domestic investors also had little interest in trading, the brokers said.

"Most institutions are remaining on the sidelines, which made the market very sluggish," one broker said. "Some of them are waiting for clearer direction and have turned their focus to other more attractive markets."
Two new B share issues -- Shanghai Port Machinery and Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal -- are expected to be listed in August, and that has also drawn away some of the market's attention, brokers said.
"The index will test the technical support level of 73 points in the afternoon," another broker said.
Hainan Airlines said on Wednesday it was seeking compensation of about $2.25 million from an aircraft maintenance company for damage to one of its planes during routine repairs.
Trading in the company's B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume this afternoon.
"The price of Hainan Airlines is likely to fall in the afternoon as losing one plane means they should rearrange their flying plan, which can lead to falls in turnover," one broker said.
Of 45 B share issues, 34 were traded, with 17 down, 10 unchanged and seven higher.
China First Penci was the biggest loser on speculative selling, falling $0.020 or 5.55 percent to $0.340 on volume of 67,500 shares.
Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor was the most actively traded on institutional selling, losing $0.010 or 2.50 percent to $0.390 on volume of 517,300 shares.
Shanghai's A share index continued to rebound, but trading was still slow amid cautious market sentiment, brokers said.
The index rose 17.057 points or 1.41 percent to 1,223.115 on volume of 154.0 million shares worth 1.5 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index put on 48.627 points or 1.33 percent to 3,695.758 points.
Shanxi Xing Hua Cun Fenjiu Distillery was the star performer on speculative buying, jumping 0.46 yuan or 7.89 percent to 6.29 yuan on volume of 1.6 million shares.
